faq: What materials does GC Laser Cut cut?
MDF 3 to 12 mm, acrylic 2 to 10 mm, PVC-free vinyl, leather 1 to 5 mm, thin polycarbonate 1 to 3 mm and timber 3 to 18 mm. We do not cut metal of any kind.
No. We do not cut steel, stainless, aluminium, brass, copper or any other metal. Our 130 W CO2 laser is built for sheet goods such as timber, MDF, acrylic and leather.
What is the largest sheet you can cut?
Up to 1300 by 900 mm in one piece. Larger designs are split into panels that join on assembly.
What file formats do you accept?
DXF, SVG, AI and PDF drawn at 1:1 scale in millimetres. A JPG or sketch is fine for a quote and we can redraw it for cutting.
How long will my job take?
Most jobs are ready in 3 to 5 working days from approval. Quotes are sent within 24 hours.
How much does laser cutting cost?
Machine time is $65 per hour plus a $20 setup fee for a new design. Complex designs add 15 percent and jobs over 10 hours receive 10 percent off. Material is quoted separately.
